name: Kusaka Yukimitsu
source: Working as agent of a secret organization, he failed his mission to protect his client Alice and was accused of murder by his own organization to avoid troubles. Losing everything, he runs away from Japan and comes to Eleutheria island to start over. There, he has the fateful encounter with a girl named Unica who resembles Alice very much.
